## Pull request checklist

- [ ] I have read the CONTRIBUTING guide.
- [ ] I have checked for secrets or sensitive data.
- [ ] I have run the relevant tests or validation checks.
- [ ] I have documented the change where needed.
- [ ] I understand this project is subject to the ownership and commercial-use restrictions.

## Summary
Describe what changed and why.

## Testing
Describe how you validated the change.

## Screenshots
If UI changed, add screenshots or a short video.
